notes.title: Slitherine lands on Bundle Stars!
notes.content:
Amazing news!

We are happy to announce that [b]Slitherine lands on Bundle Stars![/b]

Starting from today a number of our games will be sold on the Bundle Stars store at a very special discount price!

If you are of a mind to save don’t miss this amazing offer. A whole[b] Slitherine bundle[/b] comprising of three different tiers with so many titles at an incredibly cheap price. Three games for 1.99$, seven for 3.99$ and eight for 7.99$!

https://www.bundlestars.com/en/bundle/slitherine-bundle

The details of the bundle are as follow:

[b]Tier 1: $1.99[/b]

- Battle of the Bulge 
- Time of Fury 
- Pride of Nations 
[b]
Tier 2: $3.99 (including Tier 1!) [/b]

- Vietnam ‘65 
- Ravenmark
- Legions of Steel
- Close Combat Panthers in the Fog
[b]
Tier 3: $7.99 (Including Tier 1 and Tier 2!)[/b]

The Bundle offer is valid until May 14th! 

But it’s not all, folks. Be sure not to miss these amazing discounts on some of our other titles:

Battle Academy – 75% off!
Battle Academy 2: Eastern Front – 75% off!
Battle of the Bulge – 33% off!
Buzz Aldrin’s Space Program Manager – 50% off!
Distant Worlds: Universe – 50% off!
Last Days of Old Earth – 15% off!
Order of Battle: Pacific – 40% off!
Vietnam ’65 – 50% off!
Warhammer 40,000: Armageddon – 35% off!

All the discounts will be valid for 72 hours.
[i][u]
By buying these titles on Bundle Stars you will receive Steam keys and you will need to activate the products on Steam.[/u][/i]

What are you waiting for? Don’t miss this unique opportunity and [url=https://www.bundlestars.com/en/bundle/slitherine-bundle]visit the Bundle Stars store now![/url]

notes.title: Legions of Steel Version 1.0.1 is available!
notes.content:
Hi everybody!

Legions of Steel has been updated to Version 1.0.1! 

Here's the changelog:

v1.0.1
· UI and texts fixes
· Added Edge scrolling switch to options menu
· Hotkeys when opening the Fire Button fixed
· Zoom in/out added on "x" and "z" keys, for players using a wheel-less mouse
· Warning about units yet to be moved more prominent
· Fixes for the non-working multiplayer achievements
· Fix for the game logo disappearing when going from the multiplayer section to the main
menu when the Internet connection is lost
· Minor stability issues solved
· Game manual updated in French language
· Fix for the bug preventing games set in French language to complete multiplayer Phase
commit
· Fix for the Campaign 2 Experience confirmation message not displayed
· Fix for the first Dodge action of the Turn that was bugging the game

notes.title: Board Em Up: Legions Of Steel Goes From Tabletop To PC
notes.content:
Often when I’m in a pub I’ll regail strangers with great tales of how I’ll one day make my millions by pitching game developers great ideas I’ve stolen from board games I once played in a recroom during the ’90s. It’s a great tragedy that Studio Nyx got there ahead of me with Legions of Steel [official site], which if you’re old enough you might recognise as an old tactical board game about saving humanity from mechanical jerks.

The original rule-set has been recreated for its PC release by the French studio – The game’s out now and you can watch in action below:

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Legions of Steel is out! With a Stream!
notes.content:
The first thing you see is the sky covered by falling stars. Next you observe explosions scarring the ground and destroying your cities. When it's too late, you realize what is truly happening. Your planet doesn't belong to you anymore. It belongs to the Machines!

[b]Legions of Steel[/b] is releasing today! The game depicts a dark future where the majority of the races inhabiting the Milky Way are driven to unite against the deadliest menace of all: endless hordes of sentient machines devoted to the annihilation of all other species. These latter formed an Alliance trying to cripple the enemy by knocking out their underground facilities. This kind of mission is not suitable for large groups of units and the Alliance is forced to rely on smaller - but better trained and equipped - squads named Commando!

[b]Legions of Steel[/b] is a tactical board game where battles are fought in a dark and dangerous environment. French developer Studio Nyx have managed to re-create the deep and challenging set of rules, giving players plenty of shooting and movement options.

Two challenging campaigns are designed to make you feel the sensation of fighting in a hostile and narrow complex of underground facilities, where the wrong order to only one of your men could bring the destruction of you entire squad thanks to a very pro active AI.

And if you are eager to engage other humans don't miss the chance to try our flexible and dynamic Tournament System which uses a non-elimination format. The best for a more challenging experience!

[b]But the news about the game is not over![/b]

In order to show you all of its features, [b]we will stream it today at 20:00 CEST / 18:00 UTC / 2:00 PM  EDT on our official [url=http://www.twitch.tv/slitherinegroup]Twitch Channel![/url][/b] 

And last but not least, while the game is available for PC , we wish to announce a [url=slitherine.com/beta_test]beta call[/url] for the [b]Android version of the game![/b]

notes.title: Legions of Steel Saturday Twitch – The Machines are here!
notes.content:
On tomorrow’s Twitch Stream of [b]Legions of Steel[/b] you’ll have the chance to watch the formidable Empire of the Machines fighting mankind! 

[b]Agrippa Maxentius[/b] will start the battle on [b]Saturday 11th at 20:00 CEST / 18:00 UTC / 2:00 PM EDT[/b] on our Official [url=http://www.twitch.tv/slitherinegroup]Twitch Channel![/url]

Legions of Steel is our upcoming sci-fi tactical game, where players have to lead a squad of highly trained Commandos in dangerous environments with plenty of firing and movement options at their disposal.

notes.title: Legions of Steel - Meet the Commandos
notes.content:
Planet after planet the Machines are expanding their Empire over the Galaxy. Scattered and isolated even the most powerful civilizations are forced to fall back to avoid extinction.

The only way to halt the steel nightmares seems to be to infiltrate and destroy their underground production facilities. Soon all the major races start to train joint Special Forces in order to achieve this goal and repel the invaders.

These bravest of the brave are called [b]The Commandos![/b]

Get more information of the game from its Official [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/312440/]Product Page[/url]

[img]http://www.slitherine.com/img/Trooper.jpg[/img]
[i]Trooper
The backbone of every Commando squad, these basic shock troops are well trained and flexible for most tactical situations[/i]

[img]http://www.slitherine.com/img/Corporal.jpg[/img]
[i]Corporal
Those who survived some battles against the Machines have the task to inspire the rookies and to keep them united  [/i]

[img]http://www.slitherine.com/img/Heavy%20Weapon.jpg[/img]
[i]Heavy Weapon
In the grim and narrow tunnels of the Machines, superior firepower is often required. These soldiers have a rate of fire double that of normal troops[/i]

[img]http://www.slitherine.com/img/Sergeant.jpg[/img]
[i]Sergeant
Hardened veterans able to boost the soldiers with their movements or combat points [/i]

notes.title: Machines are taking control! Legions of Steel announced!
notes.content:
"[i]The real question is not whether machines think but whether men do.”[/i] (B. F. Skinner– American Psychologist) 

Directly inspired from the board game of the same name, [b]Legions of Steel[/b] is a fast-paced and thrilling tactical game. Squads of machines and humans fight hard in the inhospitable undergrounds of the production facilities. With the [b]one shot, one kill[/b] philosophy adopted by the developers, every move, line of sight, and action point becomes a resource of strategic importance.

[b]Today[/b] we are happy to announce that the game will be available in [b]May 2015![/b] Initially announced for late 2014, developer Studio Nyx decided to extend the development period in order to provide more content into the game, and especially [b]nerve-racking multiplayer modes[/b] that should seduce fans of competitive and intense matches! 

Players can still sign up for the beta by clicking [url=http://www.slitherine.com/beta_test]here.[/url]

Get more information on Legions of Steel from its official [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/312440/]product page.[/url]
